note: Recast from the description of the new species by Ahmad (1965), original in English; the original records the soldier only; Table 17 gives the range and mean for the holotype and paratypes; figure 47 is not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish brown; labrum concolorous with the head; mandibles dark brown, paler at the base; antenna pale yellowish brown, uniform in colour; pronotum pale. Head sparsely hairy; labrum with long bristles on the two lateral margins and the apex; postmentum with several bristles anteriorly; pronotum with scattered short hairs and moderately long bristles. Head nearly rectangular, slightly longer than wide, lateral margins weakly convex; labrum longer than wide, dome-shaped, sides convex, widest at the middle; mandibles short and thick, left mandible with a small lateral tooth slightly anterior to the middle, right mandible with two teeth, one near the middle and one at the base. Postmentum moderately arched, about 1.5 times as long as wide, widest at the middle, lateral margins convex. Antenna 16 segments; segment 2 equal to segments 3 and 4 together, segment 4 shortest. Pronotum longer than half its width, anterior margin moderately notched, posterior margin concave, lateral lobes broadly rounded. Soldier measurements (holotype/range/mean): head length (to the lateral mandible base) 1.56/1.48—1.58/1.51 mm, head width (at the lateral mandible base) 0.85/0.80—0.85/0.82 mm, head width at the posterior end of the antennal carina 1.09/1.06—1.14/1.09 mm, maximum head width 1.24/1.17—1.27/1.22 mm, left mandible length 0.80/0.75—0.80/0.77 mm, distance from the left mandibular tooth to the apex 0.33 mm, postmentum length 0.88/0.83—0.88/0.84 mm, postmentum width 0.54/0.52—0.54/0.52 mm, pronotum length 0.52/0.49—0.52/0.51 mm, pronotum width 0.91/0.88—0.91/0.90 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Among the species with a lateral left mandibular tooth and a nearly rectangular head it is close to horai, but in this species the sides of the head are more nearly parallel, the postmentum narrower, and the mandibles longer and less curved; butteli, ceylonicus and billitoni have a more rectangular head and are larger; holmgreni and anamallensis have a similar head shape but are larger.
